timestamp.description: Start and end timestamp of the segment
timestamp.title: Timestamp

speaker.description: Speaker ID of the chunk. Only present if diarization is enabled.
speaker.title: Speaker

timestamp.description: Start and end timestamp of the chunk
timestamp.title: Timestamp

audio_url.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe. Supported formats: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav or webm.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

chunk_level.description: Level of the chunks to return. Either none, segment or word. `none` would imply that all of the audio will be transcribed without the timestamp tokens, we suggest to switch to `none` if you are not satisfied with the transcription quality, since it will usually improve the quality of the results. Switching to `none` will also provide minor speed ups in the transcription due to less amount of generated tokens. Notice that setting to none will produce **a single chunk with the whole transcription**.
chunk_level.title: Chunk Level

diarize.description: Whether to diarize the audio file. Defaults to false. Setting to true will add costs proportional to diarization inference time.
diarize.title: Diarize

language.description:
Language of the audio file. If set to null, the language will be
        automatically detected. Defaults to null.

        If translate is selected as the task, the audio will be translated to
        English, regardless of the language selected.
language.title: Language

num_speakers.description:
Number of speakers in the audio file. Defaults to null.
            If not provided, the number of speakers will be automatically
            detected.
num_speakers.title: Num Speakers

prompt.description: Prompt to use for generation. Defaults to an empty string.
prompt.title: Prompt

task.description: Task to perform on the audio file. Either transcribe or translate.
task.title: Task

chunks.description: Timestamp chunks of the audio file
chunks.title: Chunks

diarization_segments.description: Speaker diarization segments of the audio file. Only present if diarization is enabled.
diarization_segments.title: Diarization Segments

inferred_languages.description: List of languages that the audio file is inferred to be. Defaults to null.
inferred_languages.title: Inferred Languages

examples: María, ¿qué cenamos hoy? No sé, ¿qué cenamos? ¿Cenamos pollo frito o pollo asado o algo? Mejor a la plancha, quiero una salada. A la plancha, vale. Y hacemos una ensalada con tomate y esas cosas. Vale. Pues eso lo hacemos, ¿vale? Venga, vale.
text.title: Text
